reviewScope: Independent original-image review of owner-approved photo-led roof-gun arrangement; no whole-vehicle or survey-dimensional qualification
findings: Long barrel, perforated rear jacket and receiver form a straight, connected line in both front quarters and overhead. No bend or detached sleeve is visible.

Gun sits on the retained canted arm and bearing/yoke assembly; side ammunition box remains adjacent to the receiver. Rear view shows the grips and supported receiver, not an empty cradle presented as an operating weapon.

Both quarter views and overhead show jacket apertures. Native front quarters show the muzzle opening. Pixel inspection cannot replace the existing physical open-hole/bore-depth and yoke-engagement tests.
The photograph supports this broad arrangement; it shows an elevated gun while the native capture is level. Authored dimensions, exact elevation and unseen components are not photo measurements.

The photographic feed box/tray and small barrel fittings have more detail than the procedural fitting. Bounded acceptance does not claim an exact photographic replica or complete accessory reconstruction.
reviewTransfer: All four R6 originals are byte-identical to independently reviewed R2 originals; R6 authenticates actual runner and all tracked runtime sources before/after, with zero errors and complete cleanup.
